name: cinema-booking-system
description: Cinema Hall Ticket Booking System - Production Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
